## Activity

During November 2023, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 109 captures. This activity represents the imaging completed by the site during the reporting period. The volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and the subsequent grading outcomes. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Image quality

Of the 109 captures, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.6. These images could not be used for grading and are included in the site’s image-quality result for November 2023. The result should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations, with any recurring issues reported through the usual local process.

## Grading

There were 24 referable results during November 2023. The median grading wait was 2 days. This provides a summary of the time between image capture and completion of grading for the reporting period. Overall, the activity, image-quality, and grading measures provide a concise view of operations at Oakridge Primary Care for November 2023.
